elements.description: A step-by-step plan from an agent: reviewed and edited as a draft, then shown while it runs.

properties.name: steps
properties.description: The steps. Edits apply unless a tc-steps-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: status
properties.description: "draft" = review and edit, "running" = executing, "done" = finished – always set by the app

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The goal of the plan, shown as the heading

properties.name: estimate
properties.description: Estimated run time shown in review, e.g. "~2 min"

properties.name: cancellable
properties.description: Shows a "Cancel" button next to "Run plan" (fires tc-cancel)

properties.name: retryable
properties.description: Shows "Retry from here" on failed steps (fires tc-retry)

properties.name: rerunnable
properties.description: Shows "Run again" once the plan is done (fires tc-run)

properties.name: runner
properties.description:
Called on run (as well as tc-run). May return a promise: the button waits, and if it rejects the plan stays in
review and says so

properties.name: retrier
properties.description: Called on retry (as well as tc-retry). May return a promise: the button waits, and says so if it rejects

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-steps-change
events.description: An edit in review: rename, remove, reorder, add (detail: { steps: AgentPlanStep[] }); cancelable

events.name: tc-run
events.description: "Run plan" or "Run again" pressed (detail: { steps: AgentPlanStep[] }, in their final order)

events.name: tc-retry
events.description: "Retry from here" pressed on a failed step (detail: { stepId: string })

props.name: steps
props.description:
The steps. Controlled when defined – pair with onChange; otherwise the component keeps them, starting from
`defaultSteps`. Edits are reported to onChange either way

props.name: onChange
props.description: Every edit during review: rename, remove, reorder, add

props.name: onRun
props.description:
"Run plan" pressed – gets the steps in their final order. May return a promise: the button waits while it
runs, and if it rejects the plan stays in review and says so

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Shows a "Cancel" button next to "Run plan"

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows "Retry from here" on failed steps. May return a promise: the button waits, and says so if it rejects

props.name: title
props.description: The goal of the plan, shown as the heading

props.name: estimate
props.description: Estimated run time shown in review, e.g. "~2 min"
